title: Online Orders Status Reference — From Placed to Closed
content:
An Online Orders order moves through six statuses: placed, processing, shipped, delivered, closed and cancelled.

## Statuses and how an order leaves each

| From | To | Moved by | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| Placed | Processing | System | The order is released to the warehouse once its cancellation window has passed and any fraud review is cleared |
| Placed | Cancelled | Agent | The whole order is cancelled before release: at the customer's request, or after a failed fraud review or payment authorization |
| Processing | Cancelled | System | Nothing on the order could be picked and every line was cancelled at the warehouse |
| Processing | Shipped | System | The first parcel leaves the warehouse with a carrier tracking number |
| Shipped | Delivered | System | The carrier records the order's last parcel as delivered |
| Delivered | Closed | System | The post-delivery holding period has passed |
| Shipped | Closed | System | The order closes without delivery: the parcel came back to the warehouse as undeliverable, or was written off as lost under a delivery claim |

## Release and dispatch

- An order is released once its cancellation window has passed and any fraud review is cleared.
- Dispatch happens within the service's processing business days of release. The dispatch date is the shipped date; on that date the order's tenders are captured, its promised delivery date is recomputed, and its Marlowe Rewards points for the online order are posted under Marlowe Rewards.

## Delivery and closing

- Delivery follows the carrier's last scan: the delivered date is the delivery scan date of the last parcel.
- A delivered order closes 90 calendar days after its delivered date, on every delivery service, with close reason completed.

## Closing without delivery

| Close reason | When | Money and points |
|---|---|---|
| Returned to sender | The parcel returns to sender as undeliverable and the warehouse receives it | Merchandise, tax and surcharge are refunded to the original tenders; the shipping fee is refunded only where the service refunds it on a return to sender; points earned on the undelivered order are not reversed |
| Lost in transit | The parcel is written off under a delivery claim | Compensation is governed by Delivery Claims |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

- An order delivered on 1 June 2026 closes 90 calendar days later, on 30 August 2026.
- An order whose undeliverable parcel is on its way back closes as returned to sender once the warehouse receives the parcel; its merchandise, tax and surcharge refund goes back to the tenders captured on that order.
